hypothesis: 同じ15%/20%/25%のAI成長減速シナリオで比較すると、NVDAはAVGOより低いvaluation hurdleを持つため、実現cash conversionを基準にしてもより大きいFCF-margin headroomを持つ。

decision_rule.use_if: NVDAのrealized FCF-margin benchmark minus required FCF marginが、15%/20%/25%の3シナリオすべてでAVGOの対応headroom以上。
decision_rule.condition_if: NVDAが一部シナリオではAVGO以上のheadroomを持つが、全シナリオではない。
decision_rule.reject_if: NVDAのheadroomが15%/20%/25%の3シナリオすべてでAVGOを下回る。
decision_rule.unverified_if: NVIDIAのData Center revenue、FCF、canonical reverse-DCF target、またはAVGO canonical frontierのidentityが不足する。

capital_allocation_importance: NVDAはAVGOより低いreverse-DCF hurdleだが、割安さだけではcash-generation余力は決まらない。両社の成長減速時に必要なFCF marginと実現cash conversionの差を比較し、NVDA優位がvaluationだけでなくcash conversionでも成立するかを検証する。
primary_sources: NVIDIA official Q2 FY2027 financial results, 2026-08-26: https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-Second-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/default.aspx
Broadcom Q3 FY2026 financial results and existing KAFKA2306/investor2 canonical AVGO frontier

method.nvda_identity: year-5 Data Center revenue = annualized Q2 FY2027 Data Center revenue * (1 + assumed growth)^4; non-Data-Center revenue is held flat at the annualized Q2 residual; required FCF margin = canonical NVDA year-5 FCF target / year-5 total revenue.
method.nvda_cash_benchmark: Use first-half FY2027 canonical FCF 69.895B USD divided by first-half revenue 177.837B USD = 39.302845%. This avoids treating volatile single-quarter working-capital moves as a durable margin estimate.
method.avgo_comparator: Reuse the existing canonical AVGO required margins for AI CAGR 15%/20%/25% and compare them with Q3 FY2026 realized company-wide FCF margin 46.179582% as the latest point-in-time cash-conversion benchmark.
method.lookahead: none; NVIDIA inputs are realized through Q2 FY2027 and AVGO comparator inputs were already canonical as of 2026-09-11.
method.risk_metrics: NOT_APPLICABLE: point-in-time fundamental valuation/cash-conversion comparison, not a trading-strategy backtest.

nvda_q1_q2_cash_conversion_context.note: Q2 cash conversion fell sharply. NVIDIA Form 10-Q states first-half operating cash flow was partially offset by higher accounts receivable from extended payment terms on large multi-quarter agreements; inventories also increased materially.

benchmark_and_alternative.simple_valuation_benchmark: NVDA baseline implied 5-year FCF growth hurdle 18.3590% is lower than AVGO 20.5117%.
benchmark_and_alternative.alternative_hypothesis: Despite the lower valuation hurdle, NVDA may have less near-term cash-conversion headroom because working-capital investment has reduced realized FCF margin.
benchmark_and_alternative.alternative_result: SUPPORTED: NVDA realized first-half FCF margin headroom is lower than AVGO latest-quarter headroom in all three matched growth scenarios.

verdict.reason: NVDA requires a lower absolute FCF margin than AVGO at 15%/20%/25% growth, but its realized first-half FY2027 FCF margin is only 39.302845%. Relative to realized cash conversion, NVDA headroom is lower than AVGO by 3.0683pt, 2.2000pt and 1.8035pt respectively. Therefore the claim that NVDA's lower valuation hurdle also produces greater current cash-conversion margin of safety is rejected.
verdict.capital_allocation_implication: Do not treat NVDA's lower reverse-DCF hurdle as automatically implying larger operating margin of safety versus AVGO. At 20% growth, NVDA needs 38.4217% FCF margin and has only +0.8812pt headroom versus first-half realized cash conversion, while AVGO has +3.0812pt. NVDA remains cheaper on valuation, but current cash-conversion headroom is weaker and should be monitored separately.

implementation.delete_or_cleanup: REJECT専用code/config/workflow/one-off scriptは作成していないため削除対象なし。

limitations: NVDAはData Center revenue、AVGOはAI semiconductor revenueを成長driverとしており、事業scopeは完全には同一ではない。
NVDAのfirst-half FCF marginとAVGOのlatest-quarter FCF marginは観測窓が異なるため、relative headroomはcash-conversion diagnosticであって完全な同期間比較ではない。
NVDA Q2のcash conversionは売掛金・在庫の増加によるworking-capital影響を強く受けており、恒久的margin低下を意味しない。
Data Center / AI固有FCF marginは両社とも開示されていない。
15%/20%/25% growthはdecision sensitivityであり会社guidanceではない。
next_high_value_hypothesis: NVDAのQ2 FY2027 cash-conversion低下が一時的なworking-capital buildかを、accounts receivable days、inventory days、customer advances、purchase commitmentsのpoint-in-time推移で分解すると、20% growth時の+0.88pt FCF-margin headroomは回復可能と判断できるか。
